Messages.Author: Powerlord
Messages.Body:
Justicar retribution, burns all minions with a current bleed of 3 or
more.

If my prey has a title non-independent vampire, does this count for
the current bleed of Count Germaine (ADV)? Will he be burned if JR
referendum succeds?

Name: Justicar Retribution
Cardtype: Political Action
Requires a Camarilla vampire.
Successful referendum burns all vampires with a current bleed of 3 or
more.

Name: Count Germaine (ADV)
Advanced. Independent. Red List: Germaine gets +2 bleed when bleeding
a Methuselah who controls a titled non-Independent vampire.
[MERGED] Anarch: Germaine gets an optional press each combat.

Thanks
Ricardo Marta
Prince of Lisboa
Portugal

Messages.Body:

> Justicar retribution, burns all minions with a current bleed of 3 or
> more.
>
> If my prey has a title non-independent vampire, does this count for
> the current bleed of Count Germaine (ADV)? Will he be burned if JR

From the rulings page:
Justicar Retribution
* Counts the bleed amount that each vampire would have when attempting to bleed
his prey.

The ruling earlier in this thread merely says 'attempts', but your
quoted link above says 'successful ... bleed'.

Your 'yes' would seem to contradict the ruling on not being able to

until the bleed is already successful.

'successful'?
